items:
Sally’s Speakeasy – Hot Tub, Golf Cart & Outdoor Living in Blue Mountain Beach

FREE 6-SEATER GOLF CART INCLUDED!
(A $150/day value!)

Welcome to Sally’s Speakeasy—a designer-decorated home in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach’s sought-after Brickyard neighborhood. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath retreat sleeps 8 and includes a private hot tub, incredible outdoor spaces, and a 2024 golf cart included with your stay!

You’re just a short walk—or quick golf cart ride—to two beach access points (both under half a mile away), with access to some of 30A’s best restaurants, shops, and trails.

⸻

🌟 Highlights You’ll Love:
• Complimentary 2024 6-Seater Golf Cart – walk or ride to beach!
• Private hot tub with string lights + shaded pergola
• Two outdoor living areas – separate dining + lounge space
• Outdoor shower for easy rinse-offs after the beach
• Exterior bar area with quartz counters
• Sonos speaker system + wine fridge & indoor wet bar
• Board games & Smart TVs in every room
• Parking for 3 vehicles

⸻

🍽️ Chef-Ready Kitchen:
• Large island with barstool seating
• Quartz countertops + custom backsplash
• Stainless steel appliances + farmhouse sink
• Outdoor gas grill for easy cookouts
• Full laundry room with washer/dryer

⸻

🏖️ Included Beach Gear:
• 8 beach chairs and beach towels
• 2 umbrellas
• 1 cooler

⸻

🛌 Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 8):
• Primary Bedroom: King bed + Smart TV
• Bedroom 2: Queen bed + Smart TV
• Bedroom 3: Full-over-Full bunk beds + Smart TV

⸻

🍹 Outdoor Living at Its Best:

After a day on the sand, relax under the pergola with a cocktail, soak in the private hot tub, or enjoy dinner outdoors under the string lights. The exterior bar and grill area are perfect for entertaining!

⸻

📍 Prime Location on 30A:

Walk or cart to:
• Blue Mountain Beach access (restrooms, parking, seasonal lifeguards)
• Blue Mabel Smokehouse, Blue Mountain Creamery, and Goatfeathers
• Nearby favorites: Shunk Gulley, Local Catch, The Perfect Pig, Red Bar, Stinky’s, Pizza by the Sea

Also less than a mile to the trailheads in Point Washington State Forest!

⸻

✔️ Good to Know:
• Check-in: 4:00 PM | Check-out: 9:00 AM
• Starter supply of paper products, soaps, and trash bags provided
• No smoking anywhere on the property
• Guests must be 25+ to book or accompanied by a parent/legal guardian
• Max occupancy strictly enforced
• Nightly minimums may be longer on weekends and holidays
• Guests are responsible for charging the golf cart. A fee may apply if it dies due to lack of charging.
• Use of the golf cart, bikes, hot tub, or other amenities is at your own risk. Owner is not liable for injury or damage.

⸻

Want to travel with friends or extended family? The owners also have two other professionally decorated homes on Flounder Street—Sally’s Bungalow (4BR) and Sally’s Oasis (2BR). Ask about availability to rent together!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located on a lake, this vacation home is in Blue Mountain Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. While the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Take an opportunity to explore the area for water adventures such as swimming.
